name: Tech / Finance Bro
flavorText: With a coffee cup in one hand and phone in the other, you are ready for work. Any unexpected delays can be solved with money.

name: College Student
flavorText: You are scrappy and resourceful. You can probably find some free stuff at the dozens of colleges on the way downtown.

name: State Employee
flavorText: Payday is still a few days away. You have survived budget cuts, hiring freezes, and mandatory trainings. You can probably survive the Orange Line.
